info.title: TalkrAI web API
info.description: Same-origin Workers proxy to Rust. UUIDs are opaque; owner-scoped resources return 404 across owners. Story persona/version mutations conflict with in-flight turns. No provider tokens in responses. OAuth callback errors redirect to a fixed login page.
